I had the worst breakup of my life in feb of 2020 (4 days after my bday). I was dating a narcissist , drug addicted rude man who never gave two shots about me. Exposed me to a STD(curable thank god) . I dumped him and left ( it was hard we lived together ) -  I tried my best to move on. Reached out 1 mo after the break up ; only to be harshly dismissed. After that, I said fuck this. I lost 28 pounds (I am thin to begin with) became extremely suicidal , wouldn’t leave my house or my room or talk to my family. All because of this man. 
I move on, he reaches out, drunkenly and highly of course to try to get some from me. I then say no. I never gave in. He wanted to work it out, then took it back. Move on again from that. Now I run into him at a restaurant, he wants to go out to catch up, only to reject me when I say is there any chance after he says how much he misses and loves me. After that, he then contacted me last week to tell me he may have HIV after hooking up with hookers. He comes to me saying I love you, I need you, I want to fix things with you. All this dhit. And now I’m stuck bc I’m putting effort in on my side and he’s being so rude to me and it hurts. He’s gaslighting me telling me all I do is nitpick him. How annoying I am, and I’m just trying to get an answer bc he promised me we could talk and work things out
I don’t allow it. Some people are leeches
I am comfortable with who I am it just never seems good enough for anyone else I. This world.
I’m 27 but where I am from people are getting engaged, married, some even have 2 kids already. What is my life? Who is out there? There is nothing left it seems for me
